scope: Independent original-bank source and finish semantics review; retained A16 render evidence is reused, not rerendered. Final level calibration and release qualification are separate parent tasks.
findings: All 221 musical originals still resolve exact named curated recipes: 22 named-row studies, 21 direct musical programs and 178 family variations. Recipe lookup throws on missing names. Finish receives the source instrument category before Hardware Studies relabeling.

All 14 finishes were applied to all 300 non-Init curated recipes in a standalone C++ probe. Only the explicitly allowed filter, envelope, pan, drift, upper-keyboard brightness and active-body brightness/decay controls changed. Waveform, pulse/PWM, footage, velocity, aftertouch, MPE, arpeggiator, modulation-rate, body-model, body-mix and body-size controls remained identical.

Role assertions preserve percussive body and brief-accent attacks, cap brief-accent release growth, and constrain organ onsets. Slow finish preserves both attack controls on both ranks of all Keys/Bass/Sequences/Plucked/Bells sources.

All 22 named-row studies retain their intended source waveform/footage/expression controls; row II swaps both channels, all four body fields and both body-size controls. All 44 resulting body-size assignments match independently indexed source ranks.

Both Init vectors retain all 198 published controls bit-exact as float32 and append neutral body sizes of 1. Init Patch retains its historical golden transform, so its published vector remains intentionally different from Init Circuit.

Explicit program-level HP, chorus, ring, bass-footage, keyboard pitch and sequence-rate/mode/octave overrides are outside generic finish. The 22 sequence rate/mode/octave assignments and source/style ordering are unchanged from the reviewed baseline.

reused_a16_audio_evidence.scope: Development original-bank voicing; pre-final level calibration. No acoustic-equivalence claim.

behavior_summary.scope: Same source recipes and DSP; only finish differs. No master normalization. Authored behavior, not reference-instrument likeness.

limits: These checks establish recipe inheritance, parameter semantics and compatibility. They do not establish measured acoustic-instrument equivalence, subjective realism or hardware-CS80 identity.
A16 audio measurements precede final level calibration. Their source hash matches the reviewed finish implementation; parent final-bank audit and calibrated renders remain the final release evidence.
Bright/dark contrast varies with source: A16 Stage Keys upper-band difference is only 0.07036 dB at its tested note, so broad claims of a large audible contrast on every source are unsupported.
A16 provenance lists finish-probe.cpp, which was absent from the retained directory when reviewed. All six retained result-file hashes match. The complete independent A29 probe is embedded below.

root_resolution.scope: Copied the original scratch source; historical pre-calibration audio scope remains unchanged.
